recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a hosted dead-man's-switch monitor such as Healthchecks.io: the `nightly-sync` script sends start, success and failure pings, and the service alerts on a failure or on no successful run by the deadline. It also says to keep the summary email and a rotating local log, and to test the alerts.
note: The reply recommends one alert: a hosted heartbeat. It explicitly turns down central logging and keeps self-hosting on the Synology only as an option, but it has none of the four labelled record lines.
